notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33892291/ebecc05c24411bd0477e7a510ca54680bbee9b9f.png[/img]

Do you like achieving achievements? Well Clean Up Clyde can now give you that feeling of joy when you receive a little pop up on your screen telling you that you did something! Can you get the 7 easily attainable achievements, and find the 2 secret ones? 

I also fixed a few issues with the keyboard controls being confusing when selecting things, and I also added a SNEAK PEAK to future games! (It's not much but maybe enough to get you intrigued!)

Stay tuned for more, including an instruction class (WOW!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33892291/9883f1b389372facfbbe7197937fe486c487f44d.png[/img]
